summary: Manifest path_rules conflict strategies (#617): schema v2 path_rules (install_as for ci.yml→plate-ci.yml, conflict root product files, overwrite labels/templates); resolve_conflict_plan drives import-payload dry-run/apply decisions.
migration_impact: Manifest schema_version is now 2 with additive path_rules. Greenfield create behavior unchanged. Adoption imports may install PLATE CI as .github/workflows/plate-ci.yml when ci.yml already exists. Loaders accept schema 1 or 2.
migration_guidance: 1. Upgrade plate-core so import-payload honors path_rules.
2. On adopt dry-run, look for create_as entries (e.g. ci.yml -> plate-ci.yml).
3. Wire plate-ci.yml into branch protection/status checks if product CI remains ci.yml.
4. Customize path_rules in a fork only if needed; defaults cover common collisions.
agent_notes: When import-payload reports create_as for ci.yml, do not overwrite product CI. Point humans at plate-ci.yml for PLATE process jobs. Prefer --strategy conservative for root package.json/SPEC conflicts.
